paragraphs: Rabbi Horkenos, son of Rabbi Eliezer ben Horkenos: Menachot 35a. His father and grandfather were great sages. In Shabbat, chapter Chaviyyot, 147a, he went out with a scarf on his shoulder on the Sabbath, with a thread wrapped around his finger; Tosefta Shabbat chapter 5. In the Mishnah, end of chapter Mitzvat Chalitzah, 106b, Rabbi Horkenos said: in Kefar Itam. In Sanhedrin 68a, Horkenos entered to remove his father’s tefillin on Sabbath eve, and his father rebuked him; Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat chapter 2, mishnah 6.
